culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Satsuki Makabe. She is also the one who made the anonymous call to Megure. Her younger brother Yuto Makabe told the truth all along because that day, debt collectors got his new address from her sister and surrounded his house, forcing him to hide inside.

summary.en: Kogoro Mouri had previously received a request from a woman named Satsuki Makabe about an ill speaking note, so he is now observing the man who could have done it. After he gets out of the elevator, Kogoro enters the elevator and sees a similar one, so he assumes that man was the culprit, but Kogoro has to take him back to the Detective Agency when he doesn’t admit his wrongdoing. There, Satsuki reveals that he is her younger brother named Yuto Makabe. Yuto blames his sister for not lending him money when he was in financial trouble, which angers Satsuki and she slaps him. Kogoro initially plans to take him to the police station, but Satsuki decides to make Yuto sign a contract not to bother her again, although after he leaves, she tears up the contract, thinking that it might continue.
